_comment: Bridge daemon (btmqttd) version manifest for the panel's update check (issue #114). 'latestVersion' MUST equal native/btmqttd/Cargo.toml's [package] version on master; btmqttd-provenance.yml enforces that equality on every change (bump all bridge-version sources together — Cargo.toml, PayloadBinaries.BridgeVersion, and this file). Because the panel fetches this file from master, its value is always the latest bridge version, with no release-time bump. Each panel's btmqttd fetches it over HTTPS, compares it to its own compiled-in version, and surfaces a notify-only Home Assistant 'update' entity (the panel can't self-flash; firmware is applied over USB).
